title: Dynamics 365 Contact Center: agentic simulations test your contact center with AI-generated calls
summary: The preview behaviour, credit consumption, prerequisite roles and roadmap details are supported. Minor corrections should qualify direct role management, complete the consumption path, identify the role-assignment request property and keep the general-availability date explicitly tentative.

claims.where: licensing.notes; Cost and licensing; Open questions
claims.claim: A simulation credit rate specifically for general availability is not yet published.
claims.quote: Searched: '"agentic simulations" "general availability" credits'; opened configure-simulation-agent, use-service-operations-agent and manage-copilot-studio-messages-capacity. Found the preview's approximate rate, not a separate GA rate.

claims.where: Cost and licensing; Open questions
claims.claim: The simulation page itself names the credit meter but does not specify a prepaid or pay-as-you-go prerequisite.
claims.quote: Searched: Dynamics 365 Contact Center agentic simulations general availability credit rate prepaid pay as you go spending limit; opened configure-simulation-agent, setup-pay-as-you-go and the capacity page. General billing routes are documented; the simulation page does not select one.

claims.where: Cost and licensing
claims.claim: Service Operations Agent's own page requires a pay-as-you-go plan.
claims.quote: The Power Platform Pay-as-you-go plan requires the use of an Azure subscription that the system charges when the agent runs. Make sure that you set up consumption-based billing.

claims.where: Cost and licensing
claims.claim: The illustrative total is about 200 credits if each of five three-minute conversations consumes about 40.
claims.quote: Each simulation of three minutes consumes about 40 Microsoft Copilot Studio AI credits.

claims.claim: The documented simulation access prerequisites are the two administrator roles, rather than a dedicated simulation switch.

Prerequisites

claims.where: Risk assessment: Data exposure; Open questions
claims.claim: Microsoft Learn does not state a retention duration for the simulation transcripts and recordings.
claims.quote: Searched: agentic simulations retention transcripts recordings; Contact Center voice call recordings transcripts retention period. Opened configure-simulation-agent, voice-channel-call-recordings-transcripts, voice-channel-configure-transcripts and voice-channel-delete-calls; no simulation duration.

claims.where: Risk assessment: Data exposure; Open questions
claims.claim: Microsoft Learn does not describe separating simulated conversations from real conversations in reports.
claims.quote: Searched: Dynamics 365 Contact Center agentic simulations retention transcripts recordings distinguish reports simulated conversations; opened configure-simulation-agent and voice-channel-call-recordings-transcripts. Neither describes a simulated-call reporting exclusion or filter.

claims.where: controls[0].ui; rendered table; Governance guidance: Before rollout
claims.claim: User role assignments are managed in Power Platform admin center > Manage > Environments > environment > Settings > Users + permissions > Users > user > Manage security roles.
claims.quote: On the Users page select a user, and then select Manage security roles. ... The specified steps help you manage only direct role assignments for the user.
claims.fix: Add to controls[0].note and the rendered note: 'This UI route manages direct role assignments only; roles inherited through group teams are managed on those teams.' In the first Before rollout bullet, qualify removal as 'remove direct assignments, and review group-team assignments, for anyone who should not launch simulations'.

claims.where: controls[0].api; controls[0].note; rendered table; Governance controls
claims.claim: The printed Dataverse v9.0 POST to systemuserroles_association/$ref assigns a role to the identified Microsoft Entra ID group user.
claims.fix: In controls[0].note and the rendered note, replace 'the body names the role' with 'the request body property @odata.id identifies the role'.

claims.where: controls[2].ui; controls[2].api; Governance controls; Open questions
claims.claim: No dedicated tenant or environment switch to disable agentic simulations is documented.

Opened configure-simulation-agent, use-service-operations-agent and capacity management; no dedicated switch found in UI or API documentation.

claims.where: Governance controls
claims.claim: A spending limit or budget specifically for the simulation consumption entry is not documented.
claims.quote: Searched: '"agentic simulations" "spending" "limit"'; opened configure-simulation-agent and manage-copilot-studio-messages-capacity. General environment capacity and agent limits exist; no limit specifically for the D365 Contact Center Agentic Simulation entry was documented.

claims.where: Governance guidance: Before rollout and At rollout; controls
claims.claim: The checklist names configuration checks that have no corresponding controls-table row.
claims.quote: confirm the voice channel is provisioned and a simulation phone number is configured ... Check which representatives and queues receive the simulated calls ... Table rows cover role assignment, credit reporting and the missing off switch.
claims.fix: The third Before rollout bullet's voice-channel and phone-number checks, and the second At rollout bullet's representative and queue checks, have no table row. Remove those configuration-check clauses if retaining the current table; no additional row is required by this correction.
